decisions.thought: Mirror match with opposing Garchomp, Dragonite, Kingambit threats. Incineroar lead gives Intimidate and Fake Out control, with Gholdengo and Mega Garchomp as strong backline.

Rotom-Wash is the best lead: its Choice Scarf gives immediate speed and pressure against Incineroar, while Primarina and Garchomp cover the opposing Dragons and Steel-types. This trio also gives us flexible answers to the full opposing lineup.
Incineroar is slower than Rotom-Wash, so priority Fake Out guarantees a flinch and free damage before Rotom can burn or attack.

Rotom-Wash is much faster with Choice Scarf, and Hydro Pump threatens a likely knockout on Incineroar while also punishing a possible Garchomp switch-in. Its accuracy is a risk, but Volt Switch would be blocked by Garchomp.
